entities.name: Query 80-aa protein
observations: 80 aa sequence; calculated molecular weight 9,212.7 Da, theoretical pI 9.60, and charge at pH 7 approximately +9.5.
Exact sequence match to UniProt Q8STS7, annotated as transcription elongation factor 1 homolog from Encephalitozoon cuniculi.
Contains Pfam Zn_ribbon_Elf1 (PF05129.19), spanning residues 2–78 with i-Evalue 6.3e-25.

entities.name: Q8STS7
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Encephalitozoon cuniculi; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated function: transcription elongation factor implicated in maintaining proper chromatin structure in actively transcribed regions.
Annotated localization: nucleus; GO terms include transcription elongation factor complex, RNA polymerase II complex binding, and transcription elongation by RNA polymerase II.

entities.name: Zn_ribbon_Elf1
observations: Pfam PF05129.19 domain detected from residues 2–78 with i-Evalue 6.3e-25.
The sequence is cysteine-rich and basic, consistent with a compact zinc-ribbon nucleic-acid or protein-interaction module.
